title: Rhetorical Move — PhD Thesis Butler v4.0
description: A rhetorical function template pattern: describes a reusable rhetorical move with Russian triggers, template counts, quality distribution, and usage guidance.

move_id.description: Unique rhetorical move ID following convention: move_{incremental_id}

category.description: DIS category this rhetorical move belongs to.

russian_category.description: Russian academic attestation (AREF) category this move maps to.

rhetorical_function.description: Description of the rhetorical function in Russian.
examples: Обоснование актуальности исследования путём указания на нерешённые проблемы
Постановка эксперимента и описание условий его проведения

typical_triggers.description: Array of Russian phrases that typically signal this rhetorical move in text.

template_count.description: Total number of templates identified for this rhetorical move across the corpus.

quality_distribution.description: Distribution of quality scores across templates for this move.

Q2.description: Count of templates with quality_score = 2 (high quality, directly usable).

Q1.description: Count of templates with quality_score = 1 (standard, needs minor editing).

Q0.description: Count of templates with quality_score = 0 (low quality, needs major revision).

when_to_use.description: Guidance in Russian on when to use this rhetorical move.
examples: Используется во введении для обоснования выбора темы и её значимости для науки и практики.
Применяется при формулировании цели диссертации и постановке конкретных задач.
Используется в главе с экспериментальными данными для описания условий и методики проведения эксперимента.

common_mistakes.description: Array of common mistakes (in Russian) when using this rhetorical move.
examples: Смешение обоснования актуальности с формулировкой проблемы
Отсутствие конкретных ссылок на нерешённые задачи

related_moves.description: Array of related move_ids that typically co-occur or logically follow this move.

evidence_count.description: Evidence metadata for this rhetorical move record.

count.description: Number of source instances (templates) supporting this rhetorical move.

source.description: Source identifier. For private builds: paper_id(s). For public output: 'abstracted'.

confidence.description: Confidence: high (≥30 templates), medium (10-29), low (<10), pending (not computed).

source.description: Origin institution or collection. For public output: 'abstracted'.
